knownFailurePatterns.pattern: The agent's own early answers, once stored in persistent memory, anchor later answers even when a later session supplies the correcting rubric; an early misclassification can repeat across sessions instead of being revised.
knownFailurePatterns.title: own-answer anchoring

knownFailurePatterns.pattern: When a later session corrects an earlier fact, keyword memory recalls both versions and the superseded value may be repeated even though the correction was retrieved first; conflict resolution is the gap.
knownFailurePatterns.title: no supersession of corrected facts
